name: Total character level (D&D 2024)
description: A character total level from 1 through 20 plus its fixed SRD 5.2.1 source reference. Proficiency Bonus is derived as 2 + floor((level - 1) / 4) and is never stored. Use mechanic.dnd2024.character-level.record for normal writes. Does not represent class levels, XP, advancement choices, or monster CR.
